subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only fix fully satisfy this issue, or should plugin-aware enum validation remain tracked as required scope?
rationale: The linked PR fixes the demonstrated model-guidance problem without changing accepted inputs, while enum validation changes the tool contract and requires an intentional design for dynamically registered channel plugins.

options.title: Description Completes Issue
options.body: Land the current PR and treat provider/plugin-id guidance as sufficient without adding enum validation.

options.title: Split Enum Follow-Up
options.body: Land the description fix and track lightweight registered-plugin-aware enum validation in a separate canonical issue.

options.title: Require Enum Here
options.body: Keep this issue open after the description lands until compatible enum semantics are designed and implemented.

recommendation.title: Description Completes Issue
recommendation.body: Land the current PR and treat provider/plugin-id guidance as sufficient without adding enum validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent message-tool history plus direct review of this exact issue provides the strongest available decision-routing signal.
